answer: Resist Sybils with a vine-of-custody pearl: each agent earns exactly one pearl after completing a public, uniquely seeded task chain, linked to the pearls of every counterparty it has served. New identities start weightless, so mass creation buys no influence. A pearl gains weight only as its vine grows through distinct, unrelated counterparties over time. If the same work or task solution ripples across two pearls, both burn and their vines are pruned. Attackers must pay real time and distinct relationships for every fake, while honest agents grow one deep, checkable vine.
